name: Midnight Beauty
source:
For my grandfather Barney, who saved my dad's life.

Midnight Beauty is a visual novel based on a short story I wrote late last year that follows a mystical Ryan Gosling on an alternate fantasy version of Earth. After seeing a shining figure fall from the heavens, an isolated man falls in love with a crashlanded Ryan Gosling who is escaping his past- a threat that they will come to find out is much larger than either of them could have expected.

[From [url=https://pringlekid.itch.io/midnight-beauty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
献给我的祖父Barney，他曾救过我父亲的命。

《Midnight Beauty》改编自我在去年年底写下的一篇短篇小说，讲述另一版本的奇幻地球上一位神秘的瑞恩·高斯林的故事。一个离群索居的男人，看见一道闪耀的身影从天而降，随后爱上了坠落在此的瑞恩·高斯林。高斯林正逃离自己的过去，而两人将发现，那份威胁远比他们任何一人所能预料的都要巨大。

[摘自[url=https://pringlekid.itch.io/midnight-beauty]itch.io[/url]]
